note: Reviewed decisions for UKG Ready values that UKG documents only as enum names, with no definition anywhere in its reference (A-26, A-79). The converter never maps a value by its name alone; each rule below is a person's decision that the name states the meaning, recorded with its reason (A-86). A rule applies only to this tenant (A-69) and only fills a value that would otherwise be UNMAPPED (A-65). UNDEFINED gender, NET_PAY and DIRECT_DEPOSIT_PER_OF_REMAINDER deposits and the *_FAILED payroll statuses are left out on purpose: their names don't say what they mean. This file is for the live UKG Ready demo tenant.
